task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First stop, make an effort to move south. Once you get around to doing that, go south. Then, pick up the sandwich from the floor of the study. And once you've done that, you win!
description:
Well, here we are in a kitchen. You begin looking for stuff.

You see a chest. Look over there! a board. Looks like someone's already been here and taken everything off it, though. It would have been so cool if there was stuff on the board.

There is an exit to the north. Don't worry, it is unguarded. There is an exit to the south. Don't worry, it is unguarded.

thought: I should move south as the first step.
feedback:
You've entered a bedroom.



You don't like doors? Why not try going north, that entranceway is unguarded. There is an unblocked exit to the south.

feedback:
You are in a study. An usual kind of place.

You lean against the wall, inadvertently pressing a secret button. The wall opens up to reveal an armchair. However, the armchair, like an empty armchair, has nothing on it.

You don't like doors? Why not try going east, that entranceway is unblocked. You need an unblocked exit? You should try going north.

There is a sandwich on the floor.
